tasks.dev: deno task dev:init && (deno task dev:watch & deno task serve:dev)
tasks.dev:init: deno task build:main:dev && deno task build:worker:dev
tasks.dev:watch: deno task watch:main:dev & deno task watch:worker:dev
tasks.watch:main:dev: VITE_BUILD_TARGET=main deno run -A --node-modules-dir=auto npm:vite build --watch --mode development
tasks.watch:worker:dev: VITE_BUILD_TARGET=worker deno run -A --node-modules-dir=auto npm:vite build --watch --mode development
tasks.build: deno task build:main && deno task build:worker
tasks.build:main:dev: VITE_BUILD_TARGET=main deno run -A --node-modules-dir=auto npm:vite build --mode development
tasks.build:worker:dev: VITE_BUILD_TARGET=worker deno run -A --node-modules-dir=auto npm:vite build --mode development
